title: Cylindrical rod
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and the translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, create the first loop which consists of a single circle. Place the center of this circle at coordinates [0.0188, 0.0188] and set the radius to 0.0188. After drawing the circle, apply a scale factor of 0.0375 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Ensure that the transformation of the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions involves rotating it using the same Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] degrees and translating it with the same translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. To transform the two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional model, extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Finally, perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the cylindrical rod are 0.0375 units in length, 0.0375 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane at the XY plane
wp = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the circle for the cylindrical rod
circle_center = (0.0188, 0.0188)
circle_radius = 0.0188

# Sketch the circle
wp = wp.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the circle to create the cylindrical rod
extrude_depth = 0.75
rod = wp.extrude(extrude_depth)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
r = rod

# Display the final model

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0188, 0.0188)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0188)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
